preconditions.description: Number of vertices n is between 2 and 58.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= b_i <= n and 1 <= r_i <= n for b_i, r_i in zip(blue_arcs, red_arcs))
preconditions.description: Each blue and red arc endpoint is between 1 and n.
Number of queries q is between 1 and 5000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v < n and len(s) == n-1 and all(c in 'RB' for c in s) for v, s in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query has a valid vertex v and a string s of length n-1 with 'R' and 'B' characters.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(output[i], int) for i in range(q))
all(output[i] == -1 or 0 <= output[i] <= 2**(n-1) for i in range(q))
postconditions.description: Each output is either -1 or a non-negative integer within the range of possible states.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] == -1 or (state_history[output[i]] == queries[i] and all(state_history[j] != queries[i] for j in range(output[i]))) for i in range(q))
postconditions.description: If a state is reachable, its first occurrence time is correctly identified.
